$comment:
THE PINNACLE, and the Ascent's Updraft gate. The bench at 64-69, 17-21 is walled with rock on all four sides and there is no way onto it on foot -- tools/gen/ascent.mjs proves that on every build, and it fails the build if the flood from the entrance ever reaches it. The board at 67,23 is the only thing that tells a player without Gale a story about why nothing happened, and it is written as two hands: the wardens saying nobody has been up there, and somebody else saying they have.

SAME PATTERN AS r8_updraft_shelf AND r9_updraft_gap. Gated on `when` rather than on a flag, so without the art the launch cell is an ordinary piece of snowfield.

lines: The whole face of the crag is pushing air upward and it does not stop at the top of it.
A bench of scree with a standing stone on it, and a view of every mile you have walked today.

$comment2: NO EXPLICIT FADES. EventHost.warp does its own fade out, load and fade in; a fade either side of it is a second fade fighting the first.

$comment: The way off. The whole south row of the bench, so a player who wants to leave does not have to hunt for a tile, and clear of 66,19 -- loadMap marks the arrival cell as already-entered, so a trigger there never fires.
